fields.statement: The night runs clean: the daemon holds new work when disk runs low, run status tells an open review cycle from a failed one, abandoning a run clears its worktree and branch, and milestones are worked in number order

fields.quote: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.
fields.statement: Milestone 12 is four change sets picked by the orchestrator from what it still watched for by hand overnight: a disk guard on the daemon, the open review cycle label, abandon clearing the run's worktree and branch, and milestones ordered by number

While free space on the repo's filesystem is under 10 GiB (overridable with daemon --min-free), the daemon starts and resumes no runs, reports each candidate skipped with reason disk-low naming the free space, and the inbox shows one disk-low item read from the daemon's state; tests inject free space through RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES, honoured only when RHIZA_TEST_NOW is set
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A review check whose latest cycle is open reports no outcome (open) in JSON, and its text reads 'open in cycle N (cycle N-1 failed)'; the live app counts it running and run summary heads it open
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: rhiza run abandon removes the run's worktree without force and deletes its local cs/<slug> branch, keeping both when the worktree is dirty and saying so; the remote branch and any PR are left alone
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: Sibling intents that carry a milestone field are ordered by its number, before those without one; ties fall back to key then ID; within a group change sets keep depends-on order then ID; this orders both rhiza roadmap and the daemon's picks
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
